title: Welcome and introduction via Zoom
summary: Monk Rowe welcomes Strassmayer from Cologne and introduces her as saxophonist, flutist and educator.

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I am in Central New York State and now I’m talking to someone in Cologne, Germany. Welcome Karolina Strassmayer.
Thank you, Monk. I appreciate it very much.
I’m going to introduce you as a saxophonist and a flute player and an educator and someone who got bit by jazz early on.
